the dermoscopic features of the LM and PAK can be differentiated by the following eight criteria: (1) the colour, (2) the structureless zone, (3) the brown lines, (4) the incomplete brown or grey circle, (5) the structureless brown or tan zone, (6) the brown (tan), structureless zone, obscuring hair follicles, (7) the blue structureless zone and (8) the scales.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the structureless zones of both LM and PAK are not necessarily a sign of malignancy or dysplasia, respectively, as they can also be observed in the context of benign lesions.
dermoscopy may be useful in differentiating LM from PAK.
the presence of a structureless brown zone obscuring hair follicles is a highly sensitive dermoscopic criterion for the diagnosis of LM, while the presence of scales is a highly specific criterion.
